AI Assistant: Functional integration tests for the lesson-scoped AI learning assistant (AIAssistantController)
Sending an in-scope question about the current lesson's content succeeds and returns a real, model-generated reply.
column3:
1. Log in as a LEARNER enrolled in a course with at least one lesson.
2. Open the lesson (or prepare POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/messages) and note the lessonId.
3. Prepare the request body {"lessonId":<id>,"message":"Can you explain the past perfect tense used in this lesson?"}.
4. Send the request and inspect the response body.
column5: - Logged in with AI_LEARNING_ASSISTANT permission; lesson exists.

AI Assistant: An out-of-scope question is deflected with a canned fallback WITHOUT calling the LLM — but first confirm the scope-similarity threshold isn't accidentally disabled by missing config (a real deployment risk).
column3:
1. Verify hango.ai-assistant.scope-similarity-threshold is actually set to a nonzero value in the running environment (check application.properties/env vars) before running the rest of this case.
2. Log in as a LEARNER and prepare POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/messages body {"lessonId":<id>,"message":"What's the weather like today in Hanoi?"}.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response's wasOutOfScope flag and the reply text.
column4: 1. Step 3-4: 200 OK; wasOutOfScope=true; reply is the canned out-of-scope fallback text, not a live model answer — if this instead returns what looks like a real AI-generated response, the threshold config gap is live and the guardrail is a no-op.

AI Assistant: Sending a message with no lessonId at all is rejected by validation before it ever reaches the AI layer.
column3:
1. Log in as a LEARNER.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/messages body {"message":"hello"} (no lessonId key).
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response status and validation message.
column4: 1. 400 Bad Request; validation message references lessonId ("Cần chỉ định bài học để AI biết phạm vi hỗ trợ").

AI Assistant: A message exceeding the 500-character limit is rejected by validation.
column3:
1. Log in as a LEARNER with a valid lessonId.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/messages with a message string of 600 characters.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response status and validation message.
column4: 1. 400 Bad Request; validation message "Câu hỏi không được vượt quá 500 ký tự".

AI Assistant: Sending a message scoped to a lessonId that doesn't exist returns a clean 404 rather than a generic error.
column3:
1. Log in as a LEARNER.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/messages body {"lessonId":999999,"message":"hello"}.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response status and message.
column4: 1. 404 Not Found, "Không tìm thấy bài học này".

AI Assistant: A learner can ask about ANY lesson by id, even one belonging to a course they are not enrolled in — there is no enrollment check on this endpoint.
column3:
1. Log in as a LEARNER who is confirmed NOT enrolled in a particular course.
2. Identify a lessonId that belongs to that course.
3. Prepare and send POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/messages body {"lessonId":<that lesson>,"message":"explain this"}.
4. Inspect the response status.
column4: 1. 200 OK — the request succeeds despite the caller having no enrollment in the lesson's course.
column5: - Logged in learner not enrolled in the target lesson's course.

AI Assistant: Supplying a conversationId that doesn't belong to the caller silently starts a brand-new conversation instead of erroring or leaking another user's history.
column3:
1. Log in as a LEARNER.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/messages body {"lessonId":<id>,"message":"hi","conversationId":999999} (an id that doesn't belong to the caller).
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the returned conversationId and confirm it differs from 999999.
column4: 1. 200 OK; the returned conversationId is a NEW id, not 999999 and not an error — no cross-account data is exposed.

AI Assistant: A Gemini/LLM failure surfaces as a real HTTP error to the caller, unlike the Learning Pathway/Recommendation modules which gracefully degrade.
column3:
1. Arrange a test environment where Gemini is unavailable or misconfigured.
2. Log in as a LEARNER and prepare POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/messages with a valid in-scope question.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response status.
column4: 1. 502 Bad Gateway (empty/invalid model output) or 503 Service Unavailable (connection/timeout) — NOT a silent 200 fallback.
column5: - A way to simulate a Gemini failure.

AI Assistant: Viewing conversation history requires the AI_LEARNING_ASSISTANT permission — re-verify live whether an unauthenticated call is actually blocked (contradicts an old, possibly-stale assumption that it silently succeeds).
column3:
1. Discard any existing Authorization token and prepare GET /api/v1/ai-assistant/conversations with no Authorization header; send it and note the status.
2. Log in as a LEARNER holding AI_LEARNING_ASSISTANT with ≥1 prior conversation.
3. Repeat GET /api/v1/ai-assistant/conversations with that valid token.
4. Inspect both responses.
column4:
1. Step 1: 403 Forbidden (method-level @PreAuthorize should reject an anonymous/ROLE_ANONYMOUS principal) — confirm this live, do not assume either outcome.
2. Steps 2-4: 200 OK; List of the caller's own AIConversation records (including full messages[]).
column5: - Step 2-4 needs a logged-in LEARNER with ≥1 prior conversation.

AI Assistant: The health-check endpoint is fully public and never errors, reflecting configuration state in the response body instead of an HTTP error.
column3:
1. Discard any existing Authorization token.
2. Prepare GET /api/v1/ai-assistant/status with no Authorization header.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response body's available/message fields.
column4: 1. 200 OK; AiHealthResponse{available, message, chatModel, embeddingModel} — if GEMINI_API_KEY isn't configured, available=false with an explanatory message, still HTTP 200.
